historical_record.description: The Commission Room of the San Francisco Public Library's Civic Center building, where a public meeting in March 1985 founded the San Francisco Bay Area Gay and Lesbian Historical Society; the building is now the Asian Art Museum.
The building now housing the Asian Art Museum, designed by architect George Kelham.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: The old Beaux-Arts main library, adapted by Italian architect Gae Aulenti into the Asian Art Museum. Design began by 1996 and the conversion was completed in 2003; the project was set in motion by earthquake damage in 1989.
